create_webhook_endpoint: create a FastAPI endpoint that handles HuggingFace moon-landing webhook events for dataset add remove update and move
parse_payload: parse and validate a moon-landing webhook v2 JSON payload against the JSON schema
process_payload_remove: process a webhook remove event to delete a dataset including cache jobs and storage assets
process_payload_update: process a webhook update event to smart update or delete and recreate a dataset revision
process_payload_add_move: process a webhook add or move event to delete old contents and update a dataset
